event: Three hours into Floor 9, the party walks the Deep Root Labyrinth in formation.
Vesper tells Miriam the giant roots bear the ceiling's load.
Nadia begs her not to cut three; the observation had knife energy. Dayo laughs.
Solenne notes the moment feels right, and wary of it.
Tomás reports heat signatures: twenty small contacts around one large one.
Solenne reads it as an Elite: a Stoneback variant colony around a queen.
Tomás adds that the root network above the chamber is climbable.
Dayo says she can take the overhead and pin them between two fronts.
Solenne says wait, they need to plan the timing; Dayo is already climbing.
Solenne orders the ground approach, now.
Dayo tops the root climb at thirty meters above the colony chamber.
She sees two dozen crystalline drones in rings around the Crystalback Queen.
The Queen's eye cluster finds her; Dayo has six seconds.
Dayo uses Anchor deliberately and feels where all five are: too far away.
The first drone reaches her; Shield Rush knocks it off the roots.
Dayo plants Iron Stance on a junction of three roots.
She blocks one drone and cracks another's carapace with her gauntlet.
Miriam's Mending Touch reaches her from thirty-five meters, weakened but there.
Drones close from three sides; a bite drops Dayo to 382 HP.
A flanking drone bites her leg: 341 HP; another distant heal brings 363.
More drones climb; Dayo counts Shield Rush cooldowns and MP as she fights.
Vesper's armored wrap holds against a drone's mandible on her left forearm.
Dayo's HP falls to forty-seven: Defiant Last Stand activates, its one charge.
Halved hits; Dayo manages the drone angles like a defensive line.
Below, Solenne channels Ley Conduit and blasts the ground corridor clear blind.
Dayo has knocked seven drones off; the rest must cross dead zones.
Arcane force shatters a root-wall barrier and the party closes in.
Tomás runs into the chamber firing, pinning drones on the floor.
Nadia follows, reading the drones' pincer on Dayo's junction.
Nadia's Pattern Break scrambles the swarm; three drones collide.
Solenne enters and reads Dayo at 56 of 467 HP.
Vesper throws a Reinforcement thirty meters up onto Dayo's shoulder plate.
Last Stand expires as the Queen herself charges up the roots.
Tomás puts three Precision Shots into the Queen's eye cluster; one finds flesh.
Solenne's Ley Conduit Arcane Bolt cracks the Queen's underside.
Miriam's Thorned Ground holds her legs; Nadia's knife lands Stumble.
Dayo fires her sixth and last Shield Rush into the Queen's broken eye cluster.
The Queen falls; the four remaining drones scatter into the roots.
Dayo stands on the junction at thirty-seven HP, eight percent.
Elite defeated: Crystalback Queen; 350 XP, three Crystalback Plates, a Toxin Filter Bracelet.
Dayo climbs down slowly and stands before the party. Nobody speaks.
Her Last Stand charge, needed for the Floor 10 Ironjaw Sentinel, is spent.
Miriam says Dayo knew she couldn't reliably reach her from that range.
Dayo says she knew Miriam would try.
Miriam says that is not the same as knowing she could.
Miriam says Dayo treats her healing as a net beneath whatever fall she chooses.
Mostly fine, she says, is not the word for a forty-five-second solo hold.
Tomás sets his bow on the ground; Nadia stays still; Vesper counts resources.
Solenne does not say I told you to wait.
Dayo does not argue or explain. She sits down beside the Queen's body.
The System records Anchor's intentional use at full party range.
Miriam kneels and heals Dayo up close, from 37 to 179 HP.
Nature's Veil follows; Miriam checks the forearm under the wrap.
Dayo sits still for the healing; ten minutes bring her to 327 HP.
Vesper sets the Toxin Filter Bracelet near Dayo without speaking.
Nadia cleans a knife across from them and makes no joke.
Tomás reslings his bow and scans the corridor ahead with Eagle Eye.
Solenne holds her pen over her notebook and does not write.
Dayo scratches a shallow new tally on her bracer: Floor 9.
Dayo stays seated, and the party waits with her.
